figurative_meaning_en: With folded hands (gesture of supplication or respect)
example_sentences_in_bangla: হুজুর, কৃতাঞ্জলিপুটে নিবেদন করি, আমি এই কাজ করিনি।
তিনি কৃতাঞ্জলিপুটে তার অনুরোধটি উপস্থাপন করলেন।
example_sentences_in_english: Sir, with folded hands I submit that I did not do this work.
He presented his request with folded hands.
history: Derived from Sanskrit 'kṛtāñjali', a traditional Indian gesture of reverence used in Hindu rituals and literature.
note: This idiom reflects a formal, deferential posture common in South Asian etiquette.
